reviews.title: Probable scam
reviews.text: As I was coming to the end of my first week of white knuckling sobriety, I found an ad for this app. I thought I would try it out so signed up for the $9.99 subscription. After clicking no through what felt like 50 pages trying to encourage me to buy more, I then got notification from my bank that 5 payments had been taken all for much larger amounts. I tried cancelling the subscription on the app, no luck. I then emailed support who told me I signed up to this when I know for certain that I did not as I would never pay such amounts for an app, especially one that I have not tried. Feels like they are ripping off people in a vulnerable mindset and profiting from their illness. The app is also incredibly hard to navigate so I gave up after 5 minutes. I’m receiving constant spam emails also which I could do without. I’ll await response but based on the other reviews )which I now wish I read first) won’t be of much help, I will be contacting my bank and trading standards regarding this.

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text:
I signed up for this app via an instagram ad and paid £7 for one course. I was then billed £37 in January (which I missed) and £37 in February. Future payments were not clearly noted on the initial order and no email confirmation was sent about future payments. 

Furthermore the app only allows you to manage the subscription via the AppStore but the subscription does not show in AppStore subscriptions so it’s impossible to unsubscribe. 

The owners have refused to refund the payments collected and instead offered to unlock lifetime VIP access for the money already paid. Which I do not want. 

This is clearly an attempt to trick people and scam them out of money. Their operations are illegal under UK consumer law and I have disputed the additional payments with my card provider. 

The majority of reviews on here are too similar to be real. The rest of the reviews like mine are likely the only real ones. AVOID

reviews.title: Misleading “Free Trial” and Repeated Unauthorized Charges
reviews.text:
I signed up for what was advertised as a free trial, and shortly after that they started charging my card without authorization. They made three charges at once.

When I contacted them asking to stop the charges, they replied saying that due to an “error” they would give me VIP access to their courses instead. I clearly told them I did not want any access, that I wanted my money refunded and the subscription canceled.

After that message, they completely stopped responding. They do not reply to emails, they have no phone number to contact, they have not refunded my money, and they refuse to cancel the subscription they created without my consent.

This is extremely unprofessional and unethical. Be very careful — do not download this app. This is misleading, deceptive, and feels like a scam. I am still waiting for a refund and for the subscription to be canceled, and no one responds.
